content.title: The Complete Guide to Selling Digital Products Without Stripe

content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers: Plugins online

Stripe is designed for high-volume businesses and offers a robust payment processing solution, but its reach is limited to just 46 countries. This means that millions of potential creators are excluded from a reliable payment infrastructure. PayPal, while more widely known, imposes restrictions and can suspend accounts without recourse, rendering it unreliable for those in restricted regions. Gumroad and Lemon Squeezy also exhibit similar limitations, often failing to support creators from certain countries. Moreover, these platforms require ongoing subscriptions and fees, creating additional hurdles. In contrast, sovereign commerce infrastructures like COREMERCH offer permanent solutions that enable creators to build their own stores without relying on restrictive payment processors.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

Stripe and PayPal have clear geographical restrictions that can leave many creators unable to sell their products. Stripe's limited geographical footprint means that many creators are simply locked out of the system. PayPal can suspend accounts, leading to lost revenue and uncertainty. Platforms like Gumroad and Lemon Squeezy follow similar exclusionary practices, often citing regulatory compliance as a reason. This creates a cycle of dependency on platforms that do not have the creators' best interests at heart. On the other hand, sovereign commerce solutions allow creators from any country to set up their own systems, providing them with full control and ownership of their sales without the fear of being locked out or having their funds held hostage.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

The payment speed and fees associated with traditional processors can be a major concern for creators. Stripe charges around 2.9% plus a fixed fee per transaction, which can add up quickly, especially for low-margin products. PayPal's fees are similar, but their policies around suspensions can cost you even more in lost revenue. On the other hand, platforms like Gumroad and Lemon Squeezy impose their own fees, often without clear transparency. In contrast, sovereign commerce infrastructure such as NOWPayments offers a flat 0.5% fee with no hidden costs and supports over 300 cryptocurrencies, allowing for faster payments and lower transaction fees. This radically changes the economics for creators, allowing them to keep more of their hard-earned revenue.
Don't let platform restrictions hold you back — choose sovereign commerce.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

When using Stripe or PayPal, you are often subjected to their rules and regulations, which limits your ownership of the customer relationship and the data generated from sales. Account suspensions can lead to lost access to customer data, which is critical for business growth. In contrast, sovereign commerce infrastructures ensure that creators own everything after deployment. You have full control over your product delivery, customer data, and revenue streams without dependency on third-party platforms. Automation tools enable instant product delivery upon payment, ensuring a seamless experience for your customers. With tools like Cloudflare Workers and Supabase integrated into COREMERCH's offerings, you can create a fully automated sales process that retains ownership and control.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

The best choice of architecture depends largely on your specific needs as a creator. If you're looking for a quick setup and only need to sell a few products, the Sovereign Starter Stack is a solid option. However, for those who want a more robust solution with multiple product offerings, the Edge Commerce Stack is ideal, allowing for five products loaded and full end-to-end testing before deployment. This stack also sets you up with SPF, DKIM, and DMARC configurations, ensuring your emails land in inboxes, not spam folders. Investing in sovereign commerce infrastructure gives you the freedom and flexibility to scale your business without worrying about being excluded from payment processors.
How do I sell digital products if Stripe is not available in my country?

If Stripe is not available in your country, consider setting up your own sovereign commerce infrastructure. This allows you to bypass traditional payment processors and maintain full ownership of your digital products and customer data. Solutions like the Edge Commerce Stack provide everything you need to get started quickly and securely.
Ownership of your revenue means no more account suspensions.

Your Deployment Checklist

First, select the right stack based on your product needs. Next, set up your hosting using Cloudflare Pages or GitHub Pages. Integrate your backend logic with Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. Then, configure Supabase or Google Sheets for order storage. After that, connect NOWPayments for cryptocurrency processing. Finally, load your products and verify that everything is functioning correctly before going live with your store.
